states_comment: Leave empty for every country (76; about 2,000 searches), or pick some: ["HU"] runs Hungary (Budapest and its gallery districts, Szentendre, Debrecen, Szeged, Pécs); ["HU"] with "cities": ["Budapest"] runs Budapest alone (its districts too while "districts" is true); ["UK", "FR", "JP"] runs those three. Russia and Belarus are left out (sanctions).
